MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
DevOps and Cloud Infrastructure | QA Automation Background
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including hands-on ownership of CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes-based test environments. Built and improved delivery tooling across three product teams, reducing average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and CI runner costs by about 30%. Developing further toward DevOps and cloud infrastructure through personal k3s, GitOps and Terraform projects; professional infrastructure experience includes Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster and namespace-level access.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health, 2023-2024
- Built a GitLab CI workflow to deploy a short-lived application, PostgreSQL and seeded-data environment for each merge request using Helm on the shared Kubernetes cluster.
- Configured automatic environment cleanup after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams review features and run end-to-end tests in the environments.

CI Pipeline Speed-up | Odrava Health, 2022
- Profiled pipelines across three teams, parallelised test jobs, added dependency caching and separated end-to-end tests into their own stage.
- Reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%.

Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal, 2024-2025
- Built a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Set up Prometheus, Grafana and Loki monitoring, Traefik ingress and cert-manager for TLS; provisioned a small Hetzner VPS with Terraform and used Ansible at a basic level.

Flaky Test Dashboard | Odrava Health, 2023
- Collected CI test results in PostgreSQL and built Grafana dashboards showing flaky tests by team.
- Flaky test rate fell from 7% to below 1% after teams began addressing the leading offenders.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021-Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams of approximately 25 developers, covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages and artifact publishing.
- Built ephemeral test environments for merge requests using Docker Compose and later Helm charts on the company's shared Kubernetes cluster.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky-test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Developed Bash and Python tooling for test-data seeding into PostgreSQL.
- Wrote the internal guide to how the CI system works, used in onboarding; mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019-2021
- Tested web and mobile applications for client projects using manual and automated approaches.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project.
- Configured Jenkins jobs for nightly regression runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd Line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018-2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases, and reproduced bugs for developers.

SKILLS
Infrastructure and Delivery: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm, Kubernetes (namespace-level access at work; k3s homelab), Terraform (personal project), Argo CD, Ansible (basic)
Monitoring and Data: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, SQL
Programming and Scripting: Python, Bash, Java (test code)
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Other: Linux, Git, Hetzner VPS; AWS EC2 and S3 basics through personal learning

EDUCATION
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018

CERTIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
ISTQB Foundation Level, 2019
Studying for the Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA); exam booked for January 2027. Not yet certified.

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. In my current role at Odrava Health Software, I own CI pipelines and build Kubernetes-based ephemeral test environments for three product teams. The opportunity to help shape infrastructure for Corvale's new train fleet is a compelling application of that delivery and platform-focused experience.

I have improved the teams' GitLab CI pipelines by profiling and parallelising test jobs, adding dependency caching and separating end-to-end tests into their own stage. Average pipeline time fell from 38 to 14 minutes, while monthly CI runner costs fell by about 30%. I also built a workflow that deploys a short-lived application and PostgreSQL environment for each merge request with Helm on a shared Kubernetes cluster, then cleans it up automatically. These projects have involved making delivery workflows easier for developers and QA teams to use, and documenting how the CI system works for onboarding.

Alongside my professional work, I built a three-node k3s homelab with GitOps deployments, Prometheus, Grafana and Loki, and provisioned a small Hetzner VPS using Terraform. My professional infrastructure experience is strongest in CI/CD and Kubernetes-based test environments; I have not used AWS or Terragrunt at work. My AWS experience is limited to EC2 and S3 basics through personal learning, and I am currently studying for the CKA, which I have not yet taken.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience improving delivery systems, building test infrastructure and working across product teams could contribute to Corvale's fleet connectivity platform. Thank you for your consideration.

Marta Kowal-Brandt
